findings.title: Recovered-run marker persisted into later authorized runs
findings.description: The initial arm implementation applied the recovered deadline and budget whenever recovery_kind survived in state, including a terminal LIMIT_REACHED run. A later explicitly authorized run could then be refused by the expired original deadline or mismatched budget.
findings.resolution: Recovery-only arm restrictions now apply to RECONCILED or ARMED status. The first accepted recovered completion clears all consumed recovery metadata and the recovery_before validation baseline.
verification: Independent temporary-repository probe: expire a reconciled/armed run before any child, observe LIMIT_REACHED, then explicitly arm a different one-hour/two-iteration budget; new deadline and zero accepted count verified.
